person: Kostas Andreou, retired electrician who volunteers at Southgate Community Pantry and keeps bees, lives in Wattle Rise, Adelaide

mail.subject: Next month's roster draft
mail.body: Kia ora Kostas, here's the draft roster. You're on Tuesday sorting (9 to 1) and the Saturday van run as usual. Hamper packing day is Saturday fortnight, 8 am to 2 pm at Southgate Hall, and we need every pair of hands. Ngā mihi, Mereana

mail.subject: Order GC-30418 confirmed
mail.body: Thanks Kostas. Your order: 2 x 8-frame boxes (flat pack) $96.00, 20 x wired frames $54.00, 1 x queen excluder $22.50, 250 x 500 g honey jars with lids $187.50. Subtotal $360.00, shipping $18.00, total $378.00. Dispatch in 2 to 3 business days.

mail.subject: Your hold is ready
mail.body: Your hold, Keeping Bees Through Dry Summers, is ready to collect from the front desk. We'll keep it for 7 days from today.

mail.subject: Your electricity bill
mail.body: Account 5530 1927. Amount due for the quarter: $412.85. Due date: 3 weeks from today. Solar feed-in credit this quarter: $96.20, already taken off.

mail.subject: Your hives at the orchard
mail.body: G'day Kostas, the almonds and cherries have finished flowering, so take your two hives back whenever suits. Gate code is still 1945. Mind the new dog, she's all bark. Ray

mail.subject: New volunteer ID cards
mail.body: Hi Kostas, your new volunteer ID card is ready to collect from the front desk. Your volunteer number is SCP-0412.

mail.subject: Theo's birthday weekend
mail.body: Hi Dad, we're driving over for Theo's 9th, arriving Friday week in the evening and heading home on the Monday morning. Could we do the party at yours on the Sunday at 2, if Mum's ok with it? Theo wants to wear the bee suit again and take a real frame to show his class. Love, Soph

mail.subject: Rates notice: second instalment
mail.body: Property: 14 Banksia Crescent, Wattle Rise. The second instalment of $486.00 is due in 24 days. Pay online with reference 7720 4415 or at the council office.

mail.subject: This month's meeting: varroa update
mail.body: Hi members, our meeting is Thursday week at 7:30 pm at the Scout Hall on Kingfisher Road. Guest speaker Dr Anjali Rao will cover the varroa response and what the new rules mean for hobby keepers. Please bring a plate to share.

mail.subject: school project
mail.body: Hi Pappou, can I interview you for my school project on jobs people did 50 years ago? Only 15 minutes. I'll bring my questions when we come for Theo's party. Mia x

mail.subject: Food safety refresher
mail.body: Hi all, the food handling refresher is compulsory for everyone on sorting. Two sessions, both the week after next: Monday at 10 am or Thursday at 6 pm, at the Pantry, about 90 minutes each. Tell me which one you'll do.

mail.subject: Order GC-30418 dispatched
mail.body: Your boxes, frames and excluder are on their way with Koala Freight, tracking KF 5512 0834, estimated 4 to 5 business days. The honey jars ship separately from our second warehouse and may take a few days longer.

mail.subject: Spare queens
mail.body: Kostas, I've got two spare mated queens from my splits if you want one for that weak hive of yours. $35 each. Let me know by the weekend or they go to someone else. Lucas

mail.subject: Pantry news
mail.body: This month so far: 1,240 households served and 9.6 tonnes of food handed out. Volunteer of the month: Kostas Andreou, for 11 years of Saturday van runs!

mail.subject: Appointment reminder
mail.body: Dear Kostas, this is a reminder of your appointment with Dr Priya Ramanathan on Tuesday week at 2:40 pm for your annual check-up. Please bring your health card and a list of your current medicines.

mail.subject: Theo's party
mail.body: Kos, can you pick up the cake from Crumb & Co on Sunday week? It's paid and under my name, ready from 10. We'll need more chairs too, maybe ask the Pallisters? L xx

mail.subject: Hearing assessment booked
mail.body: Hi Kostas, your hearing assessment is booked for Thursday week at 9:15 am with audiologist Ben Nguyen at our Glenhaven clinic, Shop 3, 41 Ironbark Parade. Allow about an hour. Please avoid loud noise, such as power tools, for 16 hours before.

mail.subject: Re: Your hives at the orchard
mail.body: Monday week in the evening works. I'll leave the side gate open. My nephew Tama can give you a hand lifting if you want.

mail.subject: Ute service booking
mail.body: Hi Kostas, your ute (rego S418 KTA) is booked in for its 60,000 km service on Monday week, drop-off 8 am. Estimate $465 including oil and filters; brake pads $220 extra if needed. It's usually ready by 3:30 pm. No courtesy car that day, but we can drop you home.

mail.subject: Thanks for this morning
mail.body: Thanks Kostas, 46 households delivered today. Heads up: next Saturday is hamper packing day, so your van run moves to the Friday before at 1 pm. Same route.

mail.subject: Swarm call-out list
mail.body: Hi Kostas, you're on the swarm call-out list for the south-eastern suburbs for the rest of this month. If called, please respond within an hour. Swarm boxes are in the club shed, code 2207.

mail.subject: Honey for the café
mail.body: Hi Kostas, the Lantern Café would like 24 jars of your spring honey (500 g) at the $12 a jar we talked about, delivered before the end of the month if you can. Cash on delivery is fine. Hamid

mail.subject: Safety switch keeps tripping
mail.body: Hi Kostas, sorry to bother you. Our safety switch keeps tripping when the kettle and the heater are on together. Would you have a look? Any evening this week except Thursday. I'll feed you! Nadia

mail.subject: Your receipt
mail.body: 2 x outdoor double power points at $38.90, 20 m of 2.5 mm cable $64.00, cable clips $6.50. Total $148.30, paid by card.

mail.subject: Part of your order has been delivered
mail.body: Your boxes, frames and queen excluder were delivered today and left at the front door. Your 250 honey jars are still on the way, expected in 3 to 4 business days.

mail.subject: Change of plan
mail.body: Dad, change of plan: we'll get to you on Saturday morning instead, around 10, because Mia has netball on Friday night. Still heading home Monday morning. Theo's invited 8 kids to the party. Soph

mail.subject: Planned power interruption
mail.body: Planned interruption at 14 Banksia Crescent on Thursday week from 8:30 am to 2:30 pm for network upgrades. Please turn off sensitive equipment beforehand.

mail.subject: Re: Food safety refresher
mail.body: Thanks Kostas, I've put you down for the Thursday week session at 6 pm. Bring your volunteer ID.

mail.subject: Stall confirmed
mail.body: Hi Kostas, stall 17 near the east entrance is yours for Saturday week. Fee $35, invoiced afterwards. Setup from 6:30 am, trading 8 am to 12:30 pm.

mail.subject: Steve's retirement lunch
mail.body: Kos, the old crew is doing a lunch for Steve Brannigan's retirement, Friday week at 12:30 at the Copper Kettle Hotel. $40 a head, let me know by this Friday if you're in. Greg

mail.subject: Before your assessment
mail.body: Hi Kostas, please fill in the attached health questionnaire before your assessment and bring a list of your medicines. Free parking behind the clinic.

mail.subject: Delivery update KF 5512 0901
mail.body: Your parcel from Golden Comb Supplies (honey jars) is expected tomorrow between 7 am and 6 pm. No signature needed.

mail.subject: Cake and chairs
mail.body: Kos, Crumb & Co rang: the cake's ready from 10 on Sunday like I said, $68, already paid. The Haddads can lend us 6 chairs. Don't forget candles, a number 9. L

mail.subject: School food drive pickup
mail.body: Hi Kostas, confirming you'll take the van to Riverbend Primary on Wednesday week at 10 am to collect the food drive donations. Ask for Mrs Tran at the front office. It's about 40 boxes, so bring the trolley. Van keys are in the lockbox, code 3381.

mail.subject: Extractor booking
mail.body: Kostas, you've got the club's 9-frame extractor on Wednesday week. Pick it up from the shed after 2 pm and have it back by 10 am the next morning. Hire $25 plus a $50 cash bond.

mail.subject: Theo's present
mail.body: Dad, Theo wants a junior bee suit, size 8 to 10. Golden Comb has one for $59. Can you check with Mum before we buy it? And no going near the hives without gloves this time, please!

mail.subject: Hives bearding
mail.body: Kostas, both your hives here are bearding out the front in this heat. Thought you'd want to know. Monday's still fine. Ray

mail.subject: Out for delivery
mail.body: Parcel KF 5512 0901 is out for delivery and will arrive today between 11 am and 3 pm.

mail.subject: Blood test before your appointment
mail.body: Dear Kostas, Dr Ramanathan would like a fasting blood test before your appointment on Tuesday. Please go to the collection centre on Monday morning, any time from 7:30 am, fasting from 10 pm the night before. Water is fine.

mail.subject: Tonight
mail.body: Hi Kostas, is 6 still ok for tonight? Bassam will be home to show you the switchboard. Lamb and rice for dinner, Lorraine's welcome too. Nadia
